question_text: A P1,200,000 building depreciates 8% per year. Value after 1 year?

hint_ladder.title: Ano ang Depreciation?
hint_ladder.text: Bumababa ang halaga ng asset sa paglipas ng panahon. After 1 year, multiply original by (1 - rate).

hint_ladder.title: Check ang Options
hint_ladder.text: Option C (P1,104,000) ang tama. Iwasan maling base or maling bawas.

A.text: You might have chosen A because you miscalculated 8% as 9.67%, subtracting P116,000 instead of P96,000.

B.text: You might have chosen B because you mistakenly computed 8% of P1.3M, leading to P104,000 subtraction.

C.text: Correct. 8% of P1,200,000 is P96,000, so subtract to get P1,104,000.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you incorrectly used P1,100,000 as base, giving P88,000 depreciation.

next_time_rule: Key Takeaway: Depreciation after 1 year: Value = Original × (1 - rate). Compute depreciation amount first, then subtract. Check your percent base.
deconstruct_text:
Isipin mo, ikaw ang nagma-manage ng barangay budget at bumili ka ng sari-sari store building worth P1,200,000. After one year, bumaba ang halaga ng 8% dahil sa depreciation.

I-compute ang 8% ng P1,200,000: 0.08 × 1,200,000 = P96,000. Iyan ang depreciation. Bawas mo sa original: P1,200,000 - P96,000 = P1,104,000. So ang tamang sagot ay P1,104,000 (Option C).

Yung maling options: P1,084,000 kung 9.67% ginamit, P1,096,000 kung 8% ng P1.3M, at P1,112,000 kung 8% ng P1.1M ang nakalagay sa utak mo. Palaging tiyaking ang base ay original value.
